providerStatus: TinyFish search and fetch_content used to find and read sources; large results were saved to files and searched locally. Company PDFs were downloaded from the companies' own sites and searched locally with pypdf. No browser automation was used.
method: Lesson-editor review of quick, helps, hurts, risks and context claim by claim against official sources. Helps and hurts rewritten as lasting explanations from annual-report risk, strategy and outlook sections; risks rewritten so they add detail or a different angle instead of repeating hurts; checker warnings fixed by rewriting or, for a brand name, a company alias.
scope: ireda, infosys, bajaj-auto, asian-paints, hindustan-unilever, itc. Plain-language and source check of pre-financial text; not a financial audit.
financialPolicy: No financial figures, snapshots or financial-review files changed. Recent quarterly results are described in words and approximate fractions only.

sourcesRead: FY 2025–26 annual report: SWOT (strengths, weaknesses, opportunities, threats), risk management, credit ratings, Gensol note
changes: Fixed the NPA warning: basics now explains a non-performing asset in plain words with the abbreviation in brackets.
Help 'government links' no longer says 'the Government does not cover its losses' (not in sources); it now cites the sovereign-level ratings.

Hurt 'Electricity buyers pay late' was not in the annual report; replaced with the report's threat 'PPA counterparty stress, land approvals and transmission-readiness' delaying projects. Added the report's threats of refinancing competition from banks and its weakness of not taking deposits.
Risks no longer copy hurts: Gensol detail (fraud declared and reported to RBI, per the annual report), policy dependence, newer technologies, interest and currency moves.
Context: removed the implied explanation of slow profit growth; now says the release gives no reason.
limits: News reports say a new chairman and managing director was appointed around 30 October 2026; not checked against an IREDA filing and not used.
